feature: Clean native iPhone Duo README preview

scenarios.name: A concise synthetic conversation is readable in the Duo preview
scenarios.given: the isolated simulator preview has two finalized synthetic transcript lines and an authored Quick answer at standard text size
scenarios.when: its iPhone workspace is opened in landscape for a README screenshot
scenarios.then: the real Duo layout shows both complete authored lines and the complete Quick answer in their separate viewports, with usable idle Start and Notes controls and no debug, recovery or alert overlay; this does not require all scrollable status controls or long conversations to fit
